newsitem.title: USA: Associated Tech president Green resigns.
newsitem.headline: Associated Tech president Green resigns.

text.p: Associated Technologies said Thursday that Neil Green is resigning as president and director.

Green is also president of the Chancellor Group, which has resigned its joint equity venture in Associated Technology and returned its stock in the company, Associated Technologies said. The group had about 400,000 shares in Associated Technologies valued at about $1 million, said George Demakos, a spokesman for Associated Technologies.

Alan Gallagher, the managing director of Main Camp Ltd, a high-technology venture funding organization with nearly $1 million invested in Associated Technologies, will succeed Green, the company said.

Associated Technologies is a holding company based in Australia with offices in New York. The company focuses on high-technology acquisitions and initiatives. It said it has 2.1 million shares outstanding.
